findings.evidence: The PDF has no tag structure. A screen reader gets a stream of text with no headings, lists or tables.
findings.proposal: Re-export from the source Word or PowerPoint file after fixing it there; the export carries the tags. If there is no source, this file needs Acrobat's auto-tag followed by a human check. This tool cannot build a tag tree.

findings.evidence: 1 picture on this page. The file has no tags, so no picture can carry alt text or be marked decorative.
findings.proposal: Fix it in the source and export again with tags on. With no source: tag the file in Acrobat, then for each picture on this page, Set alternate text: alt text that says what it shows, or tick Decorative figure.

findings.evidence: 2 fill-in fields with no tooltip; a screen reader announces the internal name: 'Text Field0', 'Text Field1'.
findings.proposal: For each field on this page, Acrobat: All tools › Prepare a form › right-click the field › Properties › General › Tooltip, and type what goes in it, in the words printed beside it.
